db_conn_string.description: Database connection string for the PostgreSQL coordinator. Supports libpq-style DSNs (e.g., 'host=localhost port=5432 dbname=pgq user=pgq password=secret').

user.description: PostgreSQL username used for queue operations (fallback if not embedded in connection string).

database.description: PostgreSQL database name containing pgq tables and queues.

host.description: PostgreSQL server host (hostname or IP). Leave empty to use Unix socket (if socket_path unset, use default socket dir).

port.description: PostgreSQL server port (ignored if host is a Unix socket path).

socket_path.description: Path to PostgreSQL Unix domain socket directory (e.g., '/var/run/postgresql'). Overrides host and port.

log_dir.description: Directory where pgq log files are written. Must be writable by the pgq user.

log_file.description: Base name for log files. Supports strftime patterns (e.g., 'pgq-%Y%m%d.log').

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or FATAL.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads per queue (applies globally unless overridden per-queue). Set to 0 to disable workers and run only coordinator.

worker_max_batch.description: Maximum number of items a worker processes per tick.

worker_tick_delay.description: Delay (ms) between worker ticks when no work is available.

worker_tick_interval.description: Delay (ms) between worker ticks regardless of work availability.

worker_conn_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a database connection.

worker_query_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a query to complete.

auto_create_tables.description: Automatically create required pgq tables and extensions on startup if missing.

coordinator_enabled.description: Enable the coordinator process (required for queue maintenance and ticker tasks).

coordinator_tick_timeout.description: Coordinator tick timeout in seconds (kills stuck ticks).

queues.description: List of queue definitions. Each queue runs independently with its own workers and settings.

name.description: Unique name for this queue (alphanumeric + underscores).

consumer_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated consumer names. If empty, consumers must register with explicit names.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads for this queue (overrides global worker_count).

max_batch.description: Max items processed per tick by workers for this queue.

max_lag_ms.description: Maximum lag (ms) between event insertion and processing before warning logs are emitted.

ticker_enabled.description: Whether the coordinator runs a ticker for this queue. Defaults to coordinator.enabled.

forward_targets.description: List of remote queue forwarding rules (multi-tier deployment support).

source_queue.description: Name of the local queue to forward.

dest_db.description: Connection string for the destination database (e.g., 'postgresql://user:pass@remote:5432/pgq').

dest_user.description: Username for the destination database (optional; fallback).

dest_table.description: Destination table name for forwarded events.

monitor_script.description: Absolute path to an executable shell script called after each coordinator tick. Receives queue status as arguments. Use only in trusted environments.
